title: Qualification Reconciliation and Deployment Readiness Audit

scope_1_memory_criterion_resolution.provenance_analysis: The 35 MB figure originates in Stage 11.2.33 (Section 2, Discrepancy 4) as an analytical estimate for a custom embedded native runtime (Tract/Rust): 'In a native Rust/C/Tract runtime, peak RSS includes allocator heap fragmentation and thread stack allocations (budgeted at < 35 MB RSS)'. In contrast, the authorized system-level process memory budget for Raspberry Pi 5 defined in STAGE11_1_READINESS_REVIEW.md is '<= 300 MB peak RSS'.
scope_1_memory_criterion_resolution.formal_verdict: If the 35 MB criterion is interpreted as total process RSS, the standalone binary at 82.46 MB EXCEEDS the limit by +47.46 MB (+135.6%). However, the static model and state component footprint is 24.16 MB (PASS <= 35 MB), and total process RSS is 82.46 MB (PASS <= 300 MB system ceiling).

optimization_experiments.arena_disable_finding: Disabling CPU memory arena (DisableCpuMemArena) resulted in heap fragmentation in the OS allocator during 10,000 frames, increasing peak RSS from 82.46 MB to 91.34 MB. The pre-allocated BFCArena is essential to maintain flat zero-growth memory during long streaming sessions.

theoretical_lower_bounds.weight_quantization_requirement_for_sub_: Because the unquantized float32 model parameters (22.56 MB) plus base ORT runtime (~35 MB) physically require >= 59.15 MB address space, no ONNX Runtime application running FullSubNet float32 can achieve < 35 MB total process RSS. To reach < 35 MB process RSS, int8 model quantization (reducing weights to 5.64 MB) or an ultra-lean embedded C runtime (like Tract) is mathematically mandatory.

scope_6_limitations_register.host_vs_pi5_hardware_gap: Evaluated on macOS ARM64 (Apple M4); physical Raspberry Pi 5 single-thread execution will incur higher latency and differs in cache hierarchy.
scope_6_limitations_register.single_model_vs_ensemble: Executable implements FullSubNet Candidate B alone (70% weight); the frozen tri-model ensemble (15% DFN3 + 70% FullSubNet + 15% GTCRN) is not yet integrated.
scope_6_limitations_register.algorithmic_latency_floor: FullSubNet has an inherent 48.0 ms algorithmic delay (16 ms STFT + 32 ms lookahead) which exceeds the provisional 35.0 ms project target.
scope_6_limitations_register.anc_integration: Dual-microphone reference-channel adaptive ANC (NLMS) is not yet integrated with the streaming neural enhancement pipeline.
scope_6_limitations_register.dataset_scope: Evaluated on 10 development clips; gold test benchmark remains strictly sealed.

governance_verdict.recommendation: Submit Stage 11.2.34.4 audit report to reviewer for formal sign-off and direction regarding Stage 11.2.35.
